about_the_game:
When you open your eyes, you find yourself on a familiar stairs. You are trapped in a school where time seems to have stopped.

From somewhere, you hear a voice.

In one of the classrooms, a girl stands quietly. Even when you try to speak to her, she does not respond.

Alone in the empty school building, your only option is to head for the rooftop.

“NO LIFE BABY OF THE END” is a walking simulator set in a school overrun by zombies.

Pay close attention to your surroundings and make your way to the rooftop.
